villain.name: Morgan
villain.quote: I am the answer to prayers you should have never made.
villain.backstory: Once Morgan walked among the innocent, until The Loss shattered their world. From the ashes rose Lord Void, wielding air control as both weapon and curse.

posts.text: I built a cinematic villain origin story generator. Enter your name and discover your inner villain. Mine is The Collector Prime, "The Cursed Blade", with the power of Soul Eater. What's yours?

villain.name: Avery
villain.quote: When no one else can be trusted — trust yourself. Only yourself.
villain.backstory: They called Avery a hero, until The Betrayal revealed the truth: heroes always fall. Now reborn as The Collector Prime, they command soul eater.

posts.text: I'm Vesper Omega, "The Eternal Dusk", Threat Level B. What villain did you get? 🦹‍♀️

villain.name: Quinn
villain.quote: I did not become a villain. The world made me one.
villain.backstory: The world betrayed Quinn, and The Exile was the final straw. Rising from despair as Vesper Omega, they now command illusion mastery.
